elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 14 begins the added obligations with: “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance to Client.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) requires TrueLink, at Client’s request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at TrueLink’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) expressly states “at TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: TrueLink must return Customer Data to Client within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b), governed by the expiry-or-termination trigger, requires TrueLink “within thirty (30) days” to return all Client Content, Client Proprietary Information, and borrower and loan data to Client.

elements.element: The returned Customer Data must be provided in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: TrueLink must delete the returned Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: TrueLink must certify deletion of the Customer Data after deletion.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: TrueLink must provide transition assistance to Client.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) requires TrueLink, at Client’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The six-month assistance period exceeds and encompasses the fallback ninety-day period.

elements.element: TrueLink must export or return Customer Data to Client.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return to Client of all Client Content, Client Proprietary Information, and borrower and loan data.

elements.element: The Customer Data export or return must occur within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b), under the expiry-or-termination trigger, expressly requires return “within thirty (30) days.”

result.reason: The redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It adds only exit-related transition, data-return, deletion, and certification duties. Existing Client obligations to arrange replacement hosting and name-server services remain effective and are not contradicted. The drafting is clear, although deletion and certification are required only “thereafter,” without a fixed completion deadline.
